correctness.rationale: The primary §4.1 establishes the sharp constant and nonzero constant modulus. Equality in all noncritical Cauchy–Schwarz fibers forces orthogonal rectangle identities. Their multiplicative mixed differences are constant by comparison of two independent scalar coordinates and collinear decomposition. This yields a symmetric bicharacter vanishing on orthogonal pairs; factorization through every dot-product functional and bilinear compatibility give B(a,b)=ψ(δ a·b). Removing ψ((δ/2)Q) leaves an additive character. Conversely target translations preserve the fourth moment; full-field trace nondegeneracy proves q³ distinct projective classes. The packaged verifier confirms ranks for p=3,7,11, without extrapolating finite calculations.
